capabilities.name: Project governance

capabilities.name: Project management

capabilities.name: Demand management

capabilities.name: Time tracking

capabilities.name: Collaborative work management

capabilities.name: Innovation / idea management
capabilities.description: Crowdsource, evaluate and progress ideas.

capabilities.name: Value stream management

capabilities.name: Workflow automation

products.name: Planview Portfolios
products.summary: Strategic portfolio management (SPM) solution for connecting strategy, funding, resources and delivery across the enterprise.

capabilities.notes: Project scheduling is supported; collaborative task execution is often paired with a work-management product.
Agile delivery is typically connected via Planview AgilePlace and/or Planview Hub.
Via Planview Hub or integration services.

sources.title: Planview Portfolios - product overview (Avantra summary)

implementationConsiderations: Agree the portfolio hierarchy, lifecycle stage-gates and financial planning model before configuration.
Resource master data quality (roles, skills, availability) is the main driver of capacity-planning value.
Plan ERP/finance integration for actuals early if financial management is in scope.
Typical enterprise roll-outs are phased (PMO/portfolio first, then resource and financial management).

products.name: Planview AdaptiveWork
products.summary: Project and work management solution for planning and executing projects with collaborative work management, resource management and workflow automation.

sources.title: Planview AdaptiveWork - product overview (Avantra summary)

implementationConsiderations: Highly configurable - define workflow automation and custom data model governance up front to avoid configuration sprawl.
Confirm whether enterprise-level strategic and financial portfolio planning needs exceed project-level capabilities.

products.name: Planview AgilePlace
products.summary: Visual Kanban-based work management for agile teams and teams-of-teams, connecting team-level delivery to planning.

capabilities.notes: OKR support to be verified by curator.
Integration with developer tools via Planview Hub or connectors.

sources.title: Planview AgilePlace - product overview (Avantra summary)

implementationConsiderations: Define board standards (lanes, card types, WIP limits) centrally to keep teams-of-teams reporting consistent.
Decide the system of record per team (AgilePlace vs. Jira/Azure DevOps) before integrating.

products.name: Planview ProjectPlace
products.summary: Collaborative work management for teams to plan, share documents and track work using boards and plans.

sources.title: Planview ProjectPlace - product overview (Avantra summary)

implementationConsiderations: Best suited to team collaboration; pair with a portfolio product when enterprise portfolio governance is required.

products.name: Planview IdeaPlace
products.summary: Innovation management to crowdsource, evaluate and progress ideas into the portfolio.

sources.title: Planview IdeaPlace - product overview (Avantra summary)

implementationConsiderations: Define idea challenge governance and the hand-off from idea to funded demand.

products.name: Planview Hub
products.summary: Integration platform that synchronises work items across software delivery and portfolio tools (for example Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow).

sources.title: Planview Hub - product overview (Avantra summary)

implementationConsiderations: Model artifact mappings (e.g. epic/feature/story) and conflict rules per integration before go-live.
On-premises deployment availability to be confirmed with Planview for the customer's scenario.

products.name: Planview Viz
products.summary: Value stream management providing flow metrics on software delivery.

sources.title: Planview Viz - product overview (Avantra summary)

implementationConsiderations: Requires integration with delivery tools (typically via Planview Hub) to obtain flow data.

products.summary: Project portfolio management focused on fast time-to-value for portfolio, project, resource and time management.

fitRules.description: Agile delivery + portfolio governance: connect Planview Portfolios with Planview AgilePlace
fitRules.rationale: Avantra delivery experience: hybrid organisations need portfolio governance and team-level agile planning connected.

fitRules.description: Agile organisation with portfolio needs: Planview Portfolios with Planview AgilePlace
fitRules.rationale: Avantra delivery experience: agile-at-scale portfolios benefit from a native agile planning layer.

fitRules.description: Enterprise scale (1,000+ employees) favours an enterprise SPM platform
fitRules.rationale: Avantra heuristic: multi-business-unit governance and financial planning at enterprise scale.

fitRules.description: Smaller organisations (under 1,000 employees) may get faster time-to-value from Planview PPM Pro
fitRules.rationale: Avantra heuristic: simpler PPM requirements and shorter implementations.

clarificationRules.question: How many employees will use or be visible in the solution (including occasional/read-only users)?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Drives solution scale and licence sizing.

clarificationRules.question: How many project managers will plan and manage work in the tool?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Project managers are a primary licence and configuration persona.

clarificationRules.question: How many portfolio managers / PMO analysts will manage portfolios?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Determines portfolio-level licensing and governance design.

clarificationRules.question: Do teams deliver using traditional (waterfall/stage-gate), agile, or a hybrid of both?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Determines whether an agile planning product should be part of the solution.

clarificationRules.question: How many business units or portfolios need separate governance, reporting or financial views?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Affects portfolio hierarchy, security model and implementation phasing.

clarificationRules.question: How many resource managers allocate people, and do you plan by named resource, role or skill?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Resource management design and licence mix depend on it.

clarificationRules.question: How many team members will log time or update work items?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Team members are typically the largest licence population.

clarificationRules.question: Which existing systems must integrate (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, SAP/ERP, Microsoft Project, Power BI)?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Integration scope affects product selection (e.g. Planview Hub) and implementation effort.

clarificationRules.question: Is SaaS acceptable, or are there on-premises / data residency constraints?
clarificationRules.whyItMatters: Some products are SaaS-only; residency affects region selection.

clarificationRules.question: In which regions/countries will users and data be located?
